tickets.title: Evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s charitable gift
tickets.text: Evaluate appreciated shares in Nadia Willowdoodle’s Velvet Acorn Custody joint taxable account for her planned $18,000 gift to the Moonbadger Literacy Foundation. Assess the shares’ suitability before holiday travel.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by November 15, 2023 to evaluate appreciated shares for Nadia’s planned $18,000 Moonbadger Literacy Foundation gift before holiday travel.

tickets.title: Obtain latest restricted stock vesting or withholding detail

tickets.evidence: By October 20, 2023, the latest restricted stock vesting confirmation or payroll withholding detail from Cloudberry Kite Robotics is needed to estimate 2023 tax exposure.

tickets.title: Compare cash, bonus, college savings, taxable investment, and mortgage principal
